name: Newport Sneakers - Army Green
description: Ultimate Comfort Suede and Mesh Exterior Soft Padded Interior Reinforced Heel Raised Sole at Midfoot Level Loop For Easy Putting On The comfortable Newport Sneakers are everyday shoes that go beyond the gym. They are cool-looking and are always appropriate to wear. The exterior of the shoe consists of suede with breathable mesh sections for ventilation. The suede on the side and back features Gorilla Wear logos. The soft padded interior provides supreme comfort and a pleasant feel around the heels and ankles. The reinforced heel provides stability and protection for the rear foot. The EVA outsole has great cushioning, making movement enjoyable. At the midfoot level, the sole is raised to follow the shape of your foot which provides stability and a firm stance. Thanks to the loop at the top of the back, you can easily put the shoe on. You can choose from Army Green, Beige, and Black. Remember to never let your head down, unless it’s to admire your Newport Sneakers. Size and Fit The size of the Newport Sneakers is standard, you can order the size you normally have. Click here to open the size chart, to find your perfect fit.
